## Flagship Open-Source & Production AI Repositories
1. **ai-agent-control-plane** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/ai-agent-control-plane): Enterprise Autonomous AI Agent Control Plane with deterministic state-machine recovery, event-sourced audit logs, and automated circuit breakers.
2. **vllm** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/vllm): High-Performance LLM Inference & Serving Engine powered by PagedAttention virtual memory, continuous batching, and custom CUDA/C++ kernels.
3. **unified-llm-proxy-server** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/unified-llm-proxy-server): Universal AI Gateway & LLM Proxy (LiteLLM) supporting 100+ LLMs with virtual key budgeting, spend tracking, and sub-8ms P95 latency.
4. **enterprise-rag-data-framework** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/enterprise-rag-data-framework): Enterprise RAG & Document Agent Platform (LlamaIndex) with 300+ data loaders, hybrid BM25/vector search, and Cross-Encoder reranking.
5. **self-improving-ai-pipelines** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/self-improving-ai-pipelines): Self-Improving AI Pipelines & Prompt Compilers (DSPy) with MIPROv2 Bayesian optimization and runtime assertions.
6. **distributed-ai-compute-engine** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/distributed-ai-compute-engine): Unified Distributed AI Compute Platform with Ray Core Tasks, stateful Actors, and Ray Serve cluster orchestration.
7. **AI-Engineering-Lab** (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/AI-Engineering-Lab): 100-Day AI Engineering Production Laboratory covering inference latency, GPU memory, AWQ quantization, semantic caching, and OpenTelemetry tracing.

## Core Technical Skills & Stack
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems**: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Microsoft Agent Framework, Multi-Agent Swarms, Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- **DSPy & Self-Improving AI**: MIPROv2 Bayesian prompt compilation, BootstrapFewShot, runtime computational assertions (`dspy.Assert`).
- **Web Scraping & Cold Outreach**: Playwright, Crawl4AI, Firecrawl, BeautifulSoup, automated lead enrichment, high-throughput extraction.
- **GEO & AEO (AI Discovery)**: Schema.org JSON-LD microdata, llms.txt standard, Answer Engine Optimization for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT.
- **LLM Models & Inference**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3/R1, Groq LPU, Gemini 1.5 Pro, vLLM, CUDA, Ollama, LiteLLM.
- **Vector Retrieval & RAG**: Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, LlamaIndex, Hybrid BM25 + dense search, Cohere Rerank.
- **Backend & Cloud Infrastructure**: Python, FastAPI, AsyncIO, Next.js, Node.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, AWS, GCP, Vercel.
